title: Feedback / Donate
intro: Thanks for using {appName}. Feedback is always welcome. The quickest way to get my attention is the Feedback button above. You can also open an issue on GitHub or join the Discord.
projectsText: In the meantime, I have a variety of other fun software projects. Check out:
donationText: I love making things. Anything I've ever built has been to have fun, share fun, and make life a bit easier. If you got value from one of these things, and you'd like to chuck us a coffee, a bottle, or a god damned Ferrari, go your hardest. Then hustle over to discord to claim your supporter role!

feedback.title: Feedback / feature request
feedback.intro: Have an idea or found a problem? Send it to the {appName} team.
feedback.placeholder: What would you like to improve?
feedback.privacy: Only your name, email, message, app name and version are sent. No logs or app data are attached.
feedback.failure: Delivery could not be confirmed. Your message is still here. Please try again later.
